column1: # Baseline Sketcher partition table - SparkFun ESP32-S3 Thing Plus (4 MB flash)
# Arduino copies this file into the build because it sits next to baseline.ino.
# Arduino's uploader writes boot_app0.bin to 0xE000 and the app to 0x10000
# those two offsets are fixed. Sketch slots must be 64 KB aligned (flash MMU page).
